_what: Intake check (Phase 10): a fast look at every raw clip before ingest. Placeholder thresholds until the SOP; edit here, never in code. REJECT = do not use (ask for a re-shoot or a better file). WARN = usable, the note says what the pipeline does about it.

roles.talking_head: the speaker on camera with their own audio (script lines)

auto_role: talking_head when a face is found in >= half the sample frames and the clip has audio; else broll

codes.name: UNREADABLE
codes.rule: no video stream, or sample frames fail to decode

codes.name: LOW_RES_AFTER_CROP
codes.rule: landscape clip: its 9:16 crop is narrower than min_crop_w px (soft when filled to 1440x2560)

codes.name: NOT_VERTICAL
codes.rule: displayed width > height (the speaker must be shot 9:16)

codes.name: TOO_SHORT
codes.rule: duration below min_s for the role

codes.name: ODD_FRAME_RATE
codes.rule: average fps not one of the standard rates, or variable frame rate (avg vs nominal differ > 1%); the working copy is made constant

codes.name: HDR
codes.rule: HDR transfer (PQ / HLG): colours shift unless tone-mapped to SDR in the working copy

codes.name: CLIPPED_AUDIO
codes.rule: true peak > max_true_peak_dbtp: distortion is baked in and cannot be removed

codes.name: TOO_QUIET
codes.rule: speech loudness below warn_lufs (raised in the edit, noise comes up with it); REJECT below reject_lufs

codes.name: TOO_DARK
codes.rule: median sample-frame brightness below warn_luma (0-255); REJECT below reject_luma

codes.name: NO_FACE
codes.rule: a face in fewer than min_face_share of sample frames

codes.name: DUPLICATE
codes.rule: same duration (to 0.05 s), size and first-frame fingerprint as another clip: only the first is used
